people.name: Jehoahaz
people.line: King of Israel, son of Jehu

people.name: Jehu

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
